sentences.text: Django Unchained is a 2012 American revisionist Western film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino , starring Jamie Foxx , Christoph Waltz , Leonardo DiCaprio , Kerry Washington , and Samuel L. Jackson , with Walton Goggins , Dennis Christopher , James Remar , Michael Parks , and Don Johnson in supporting roles .	Quentin Tarantino	Quentin Tarantino	Jamie Foxx	Jamie Foxx	Christoph Waltz	Christoph Waltz	Leonardo DiCaprio	Leonardo DiCaprio	Kerry Washington	Kerry Washington	Samuel L. Jackson	Samuel L. Jackson	Walton Goggins	Walton Goggins	Dennis Christopher	Dennis Christopher	James Remar	James Remar	Michael Parks	Michael Parks	Don Johnson	Don Johnson	revisionist Western	revisionist Western	Django	Django (1966 film)

Set in the Old West and Antebellum South , it is a highly stylized tribute to Spaghetti Westerns , in particular the 1966 Italian film Django by Sergio Corbucci , whose star Franco Nero has a cameo appearance .	Old West	American frontier	Antebellum	Antebellum era#Antebellum era (1781–1860)	South	Southern United States	stylized	Stylization	Django	Django (1966 film)	Sergio Corbucci	Sergio Corbucci	Franco Nero	Franco Nero	cameo appearance	cameo appearance
Development of Django Unchained began in 2007 when Tarantino was writing a book on Sergio Corbucci .	Django	Django (1966 film)	Sergio Corbucci	Sergio Corbucci
By April 2011 , Tarantino sent his final draft of the script to The Weinstein Company .	The Weinstein Company	The Weinstein Company

Casting began in the summer of 2011 , with Michael K. Williams and Will Smith being considered for the role of the title character before Foxx was cast .	Michael K. Williams	Michael K. Williams	Will Smith	Will Smith
Principal photography took place from November 2011 to March 2012 in California , Wyoming and Louisiana .

Django Unchained premiered at the Ziegfeld Theatre in New York City on December 11 , 2012 , and was released on December 25 , 2012 in the United States .	Ziegfeld Theatre	Ziegfeld Theatre (1969)	Django	Django (1966 film)
The film was nominated for several film industry awards , including five Academy Awards .	Academy Awards	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor

Waltz won several awards for his performance , among them Best Supporting Actor at the Golden Globes , BAFTAs , and Academy Awards .	Academy Awards	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor	Golden Globes	Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor - Motion Picture	BAFTAs	BAFTA Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role

Tarantino won an Academy Award , a Golden Globe , and a BAFTA award for writing the film 's original screenplay .	Academy Award	Academy Award for Best Writing (Original Screenplay)	Golden Globe	Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay	BAFTA	BAFTA Award for Best Original Screenplay
The film grossed over $ 425 million worldwide in theaters against its $ 100 million budget , making it Tarantino 's highest-grossing theatrical release .
